name: dj-mcp
description: An MCP server for controlling playback with the Spotify Web API: search, Spotify Connect playback control (play/pause/skip/volume/queue/transfer), listening history, top items, and playlist creation. Authorization Code + PKCE with your own Spotify app (no client secret). Zero-dependency Node stdio server plus a CLI over the same core. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Spotify.

SPOTIFY_CLIENT_ID.title: Spotify Client ID
SPOTIFY_CLIENT_ID.description: Client ID of your own Spotify developer app (public, not a secret). Optional if client_id is set in ~/.config/dj-mcp/config.json.
